discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 0b6e96f80b. `factsOf` now reads only the messages after the newest real prompt (a user message whose `userRunSpan` isn't 0), so an earlier turn's edits or errors no longer drive Verify, Review or Fix; reminders, hook context and steering that core injects mid-run carry `userRunSpan: 0` and stay inside the turn.

Fixed in 205eeaa55b. A sent suggestion now records the chat's run count (and its attachments) at send time, and Undo looks for its message only among turns after that point, so an earlier copy of the same prompt is never the match. Matching also reads past the `[attached N files]` label, so a send that carried files is found and undone. A take-back that's still queued puts the files back on the composer. The label lives in `lib/attached-files-label.ts`, so adding it and stripping it can't drift apart.

This one doesn't hold. Without `-m`, `git read-tree <tree1> <tree2>` reads both trees into stage 0; it only fails if they share a path, and a checkpoint's tracked tree and its untracked-files parent never do. Repro on git 2.43: read-tree of a tree with `a.ts` and a tree with `new.ts` gives `100644 ... 0 a.ts` and `100644 ... 0 new.ts`, and `write-tree` succeeds. The path is also covered by `sidecar/session-changes.test.ts`, whose checkpoints carry an untracked third parent (including an agent-created `new.ts`), and by a manual run where agent-created untracked files showed up in Last turn and Session.

Valid, fixed. A link whose target is a directory already on the current copy chain, or an ancestor of one (`.`, `..`, a sibling that links back), is now skipped and listed in `skippedPaths` instead of being expanded again, and the number of linked-directory expansions is capped (`MAX_LINK_EXPANSIONS`). Covered by "skips links that loop back into a directory being copied": twenty links to `.` plus one to `..` finish in well under a second with only the real content copied.
